thread:
Elaine: FYI customer ask from Acme: target <1h maintenance for private upgrades, needs in-region handoff + HSM key rotation that must be auditable. Thoughts on rollout patterns?
Michael: Two candidate patterns: 
- Fast operator swap (45-60m): drain, upgrade operator, swap IPs. Short but more risky.
- Blue/green at operator level (per-tenant cutover): longer overall, per-tenant near-zero app downtime.
Priya: HSM rotation kills the short window. Auditors want manual approval + export. How can we shrink the active window?
Sam: We can stage keys (pre-install rotated key objects) and only perform bind/break during the window. That saves ops time but customer still needs audit sign-off.
Rachel: NetOps note: if Redwood does routing cutover we need a signed runbook + rollback trigger, otherwise customer must do peer switch.
Elaine: Proposal: offer 2 SKUs in console when scheduling upgrades: "Redwood-managed cutover" (premium, we own BGP change) vs "Customer-managed cutover" (no uplift). Add checkbox and tooltip.
Michael: Engineering: add automatic rollback triggers (e.g., error rate > 5% or 99th tail latency spike) and an emergency revert API. Product will define thresholds.
Priya: Legal ask: draft liability clause for managed cutovers. I'll loop in Legal. Also add acceptance criteria for HSM customers: dry-run rotation + audit export required before production window.
Sam: OpsBot: preflight checks available -> /preflight <customer-id>. Suggested gates: IP reservation, DNS resolution, KMS pre-stage, operator health, model-pin verification, KV-cache warm >= 90%.
Elaine: Can we make that checklist visible in console and required before user can pick managed cutover? UX should block request if preflight fails.
Rachel: NetOps will provide a short verification script and BGP AS-path proof that we can link in the console. We'll also provide a one-pager runbook for on-call.
Michael: Follow-up: for side-by-side operator migration we need tenant routing state export/import and a data-sync plan for any local metrics. Add model sequence-lock snapshot for rollback.
Priya: For heavily regulated customers add a mandatory staging dry-run window and a signed audit artifact. That should be non-negotiable.
Elaine: Action items: 1) Elaine: write preflight checklist draft. 2) Michael: spec rollback triggers + revert API. 3) Rachel: NetOps runbook + verification script. 4) Priya: legal language + HSM acceptance criteria. 5) Sam: implement OpsBot preflight hook and console gating.
Sam: OpsBot: scheduled reminder -> run /preflight 1717609999 tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Elaine: Let's reconvene Thu 10am PT to finalize copy and pricing for the managed cutover option. @Michael @Priya @Rachel please RSVP.
Michael: +1
Priya: +1
Rachel: 👍
